full_text_en:
Yang Xianghai Case of Drug Trafficking and Transportation

Promulgated by the Supreme People's Court No. 1 (2002)

Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China
Criminal Judgment

Case No.: (2001) Xing Fu Zi No. 99

Defendant: Yang Xianghai, male, born on October 5, 1968, Han nationality, native of Yueyang County, Hunan Province, primary school education, unemployed, residing at Baishi Group, Yuecheng Village, Wuli Township, Yueyanglou District, Yueyang City. On March 8, 1990, he was sentenced to three years and six months' imprisonment for the crime of hooliganism; on April 20, 1993, he was sentenced to four years and six months' imprisonment for the crime of intentional injury; after commutation, he was released upon completion of his sentence on July 3, 1996. He was arrested in connection with this case on September 21, 1999. Currently in custody.

The Intermediate People's Court of Yueyang City, Hunan Province, having tried the case initiated by the Yueyang City People's Procuratorate charging the defendant Yang Xianghai with drug trafficking, rendered a criminal judgment on December 23, 2000, under Case No. (2000) Yue Zhong Xing Chu Zi No. 52, finding the defendant Yang Xianghai guilty of the crimes of drug trafficking and transportation, sentencing him to death, depriving him of political rights for life, and ordering the confiscation of all his personal property. After the judgment was pronounced, the defendant Yang Xianghai refused to accept it and appealed. The High People's Court of Hunan Province, on March 29, 2001, rendered a criminal judgment under Case No. (2001) Xiang Xing Zhong Zi No. 84, dismissing the appeal of the defendant Yang Xianghai, upholding the original judgment against Yang Xianghai, and reported the case to this Court for approval according to law. This Court formed a collegial panel according to law and conducted a review of the case. The review is now concluded.

Upon review, the following facts have been established:

1.  One day in July 1998, the defendant Yang Xianghai, acting upon the arrangement of Ren Jianliang (co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced), at Ren Jianliang's "A Liang Hair Salon," trafficked 100 grams of heroin provided by Ren Jianliang through Yi Jiangsheng (co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced) to a drug addict, Cao, and obtained illicit proceeds of RMB 19,000. Yang Xianghai turned over RMB 16,000 of this amount to Ren Jianliang, personally retained RMB 3,000 as illicit proceeds, and paid Yi Jiangsheng RMB 400.

2.  One day in early April 1999, after conspiring with Ren Jianliang, the defendant Yang Xianghai, together with Qu Xiaosong and Jiang Meizi (whereabouts unknown), jointly contributed RMB 48,000 (with Yang Xianghai contributing RMB 2,000) and entrusted Ren Jianliang to go to Guangzhou to purchase 400 grams of heroin. Yang Xianghai kept 20 grams of heroin for himself and handed over the rest to Qu Xiaosong and Jiang Meizi.

3.  In May and June 1999, Yang Xianghai purchased 75 grams of heroin from Ren Jianliang for Liu Youbao on three occasions. During this period, Yang Xianghai also purchased 20 grams of heroin from Ren Jianliang and sold it to a drug addict, Feng, at a price of RMB 160 per gram.

4.  In early August 1999, the defendant Yang Xianghai, learning that the public security authorities were pursuing him, fled to Guangzhou City carrying over RMB 35,000 in cash. On August 21, 1999, Yang Xianghai purchased 310 grams of heroin in Guangzhou City, and on the afternoon of the following day, returned to Yueyang City and sold the heroin to Yuan Yingping (co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced). Subsequently, the public security authorities seized the heroin purchased by Yuan Yingping, weighing 309.6537 grams.

5.  In late May 1999, the defendant Yang Xianghai, at the request of Zhao Dabao (co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced), asked Ren Jianliang to help exchange 300 grams of inferior heroin. Ren Jianliang agreed to exchange part of the heroin. Subsequently, Yang Xianghai handed over Zhao Dabao's 300 grams of inferior heroin to Ren Jianliang and delivered the 50 grams of good-quality heroin exchanged by Ren Jianliang to Zhao Dabao.

6.  On August 26, 1999, the defendant Yang Xianghai was apprehended by the public security authorities at Guangzhou Railway Station.

In summary, the defendant Yang Xianghai trafficked and transported a total of 945 grams of heroin.

During the review period of this case, the defendant Yang Xianghai reported that Xia Chuangxin had illegally manufactured and sold firearms. Upon investigation by the public security authorities, Yang Xianghai's report was verified as true; Xia Chuangxin has been arrested, and 11 firearms that he illegally manufactured and sold have been seized.

The above facts are confirmed by evidence including the seized heroin and expert conclusions, witness testimonies, statements of co-defendants, and the explanation by the public security authorities regarding Yang Xianghai's report. The defendant Yang Xianghai also confessed. The facts are sufficient to establish.

This Court holds that the defendant Yang Xianghai's acts of illegally trafficking and transporting heroin constitute the crimes of drug trafficking and transportation, and the quantities of drugs trafficked and transported are large, and he should be punished according to law. Yang Xianghai committed a new crime within five years after the completion of the execution of his previous sentence, constituting a recidivist, and should be given a heavier punishment according to law. The failure of the courts of first and second instance to find recidivism in their judgments was improper. The facts found in the judgment of the second instance are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the conviction is accurate, the sentence is appropriate, and the trial procedures were lawful. However, given that Yang Xianghai, during the review period of this Court, reported another person's illegal manufacturing and sale of firearms, which was verified as true and constitutes a major meritorious service, he should be given a lighter punishment according to law. Pursuant to Article 199 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, paragraph (3) of Article 285 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, paragraph (1) of Article 347, Article 57(1), Article 65(1), and Article 68(1) of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1.  The sentencing portion of the criminal judgment of the High People's Court of Hunan Province, Case No. (2001) Xiang Xing Zhong Zi No. 84, and the criminal judgment of the Intermediate People's Court of Yueyang City, Case No. (2000) Yue Zhong Xing Chu Zi No. 52, concerning the defendant Yang Xianghai is hereby set aside.

2.  The defendant Yang Xianghai is convicted of the crimes of drug trafficking and transportation, sentenced to life imprisonment, deprived of political rights for life, and all his personal property shall be confiscated.

This judgment shall take legal effect upon service.

Presiding Judge: Du Weifu
Judge: Li Lili
Acting Judge: Cheng Yongsheng

June 22, 2001

Clerk: Li Yafei
